observations: A solid black coiled form sits on a flat black ground strip; a yellow spiral line is visible inside the shell, and two small cross-marked points appear near the right edge of the body.

Lines fan outward from behind the shell across the yellow field: straight lines toward the outer edges, tightly zigzagging lines clustered near the center top, mixing two distinct line behaviors in the same burst.

The composition divides into three horizontal bands — open yellow occupying roughly the top half, the black form centered low, and a flat black ground strip at the bottom — leaving the upper field almost entirely bare.
reading: A black coiled form rests low in the frame, its shell enclosing a single yellow spiral. Lines burst outward from behind it — some straight, some sharply zigzagged — filling the yellow field with a sense of pressure or noise. The cross-marked points read as weary or dazed. The large empty yellow above makes the stillness feel heavy rather than open.
